Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:
Hello !

Here's today's not-that-stupid question :
My proud Assamite bleeds for 3 with Loss.
The action is not blocked nor deflected. My prey is about to burn 3
pool, when someone else plays Major Boon.
How many counters does my Alamut receive ? Is it 0 or 3 ?

Thanks.

--

Relevant cardtexts:
Name: Alamut
Cardtype: Master
Clan: Assamite
Cost: 1 pool
Master: unique location.
If an Assamite you control successfully bleeds another Methuselah, put
the pool lost by that Methuselah on this card. During {the referendum
of} a political action, you may burn X blood from this card to give a
vampire you control X votes for that referendum.

Name: Major Boon
Cardtype: Master
Master: out-of-turn. Boon.
Put this card in play when another Methuselah is successfully bled.
Not usable if you control the acting minion. Modifiers to the bleed
amount may be played after you play this card. You burn pool for the
bleed instead of the target Methuselah (must be at least 1 pool or
this card is burned). You may burn this card to have that Methuselah
burn pool instead of you when you are successfully bled.

[Sorry Jozxyqk for not being able to mention Shroud of Absence in
this ... oh, well, here it is.]

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The action is successul (resolved unblocked).
The bleed is successful (a bleed for 3).
The target loses no pool, though, by card text on Major Boon.
Major Boon doesn't reduce the bleed; it just changes who burns pool for the
successful bleed.

Messages.Author: witness1
Messages.Body:


There is a successful bleed for 3. The pool is lost by the booning
methuselah instead of the bled methuselah, however, and Alamut only
gains counters equal to what the bled methuselah lost, which is zero.

-witness1

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <8bf00af5-685b-4ec0...@c58g2000hsc.googlegroup

s.com>, "cro...@gmail.com" <cro...@gmail.com> writes:
>So is this another case where it's a successful action but not a
>successful bleed? Or is this a successful bleed for 0? I'm confused
>because Major Boon requires the bleed be successful, so is it that
>there was a successful bleed in a temporary sense that Major Boon
>effectively cancels/changes the form of the damage to 'non-bleed' pool
>loss?

It's a successful bleed, it's just that the pool is lost by another
Methuselah.

Alamut's text says:

If an Assamite you control successfully bleeds another
Methuselah, put the pool lost by that Methuselah on this card.

So, when I bleed LSJ (another Methuselah) for 3, the 3 pool counters LSJ
loses (that Methuselah) are put on this card.

When I do the same 3 bleed again LSJ (another Methuselah) and you play
Major Boon, LSJ (that Methuselah) loses zero pool. You (an entirely
different Methuselah) lose 3.

Alamut only cares about the amount of pool lost by the target of the
bleed. LSJ was the target of the bleed, you weren't. LSJ lost 0 pool,
you lost 3, so I put all 0 of LSJ's pool-loss on my Alamut.

--
